question.text: A PM's Code of Conduct under SEBI requires:

answer.text: Fair treatment of clients, integrity, confidentiality, disclosure of conflicts

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Code of Conduct: fair treatment, integrity, disclosure, confidentiality. The Trap: Confidentiality NOT mean secrecy toward regulators; it means client data protection. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Publish the Code of Conduct on the website and train staff annually.
